property_summary: For any callee address and any forwarded msg.value, the reference contract C never reverts when Owner calls Command that forwards value to an external contract which may revert (it silently ignores callee failure), whereas the mutated version requires the callee call to succeed and thus can revert for some callee that always reverts.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call without checking its return value with a call that requires success (reverts on failure), changing whether the Command call can silently fail and thus altering post-call observable state.
